o.text: From Proto-Common Turkic *kōrï-. Cognate with Old Turkic [script needed] (korï-, “to protect”), Uzbek qoʻrimoq (“to protect”).
Borrowed from Classical Persian اهل صنعت (ahl-i san'at), from Arabic أَهْلُ الْصَّنْعَةِ (ʔahlu l-ṣṣanʕati, “people of the craft”).
Borrowed from Arabic مُنْتَخَبَات (muntaḵabāt), plural of مُنْتَخَب.
